1.stem_plain: "You must be at the airport by two o'clock, or you _______ miss your flight," warned Mother.

2.stem_plain: "She's never on time for her appointments, _______?" said Lynn impatiently.

3.stem_plain: Due to our busy schedule, neither Sally nor I _______ the latest musical performance.

4.stem_plain: Had I _______ that it was her birthday today, I would have bought her a present.

5.stem_plain: Social media has _______ influence on Kenneth as he is not allowed to use his mobile devices freely.

6.stem_plain: _______ her sister who passed her driving test at the first attempt, Siti had to retake hers three times before passing it.

7.stem_plain: The family of four _______ thrilled when they were called to receive their lucky draw prize on stage.

8.stem_plain: The little boy objected to _______ in an open sea as he was worried about the big waves.

9.stem_plain: The prefect closed the door _______ her to have a private conversation with the principal.

10.stem_plain: Having helped her mother _______ the vegetables, Sarah set the table for dinner.

1.concept: 情态动词 — Modal — will (future result)
1.zh: “你必须两点前到机场，否则就会误机，”妈妈警告道。
1.note: 一般将来时 will 表后果；祈使/陈述混合引语。

2.concept: 反意疑问句 — Question tag — present simple negative
2.zh: “她约会从来不准时，是吗？”琳恩不耐烦地说。
2.note: 附加问句：前否后肯；现在完成进行 She's = is。

3.concept: 主谓一致 — Neither … nor — verb agreement
3.zh: 由于日程繁忙，莎莉和我都没看那场最新音乐剧。
3.note: neither … nor 就近一致；现在完成时 have watched。

4.concept: 虚拟语气 — Third conditional — past perfect in if-clause
4.zh: 要是我早知道今天是她生日，就会买礼物了。
4.note: 第三条件句；倒装 Had I known = If I had known。

5.zh: 社交媒体对肯尼思影响很小，因为他不能自由使用手机。
5.note: little + 不可数 influence；陈述句一般现在时。

6.concept: 转折 — Contrast — In contrast to
6.zh: 与她姐姐一次考过相反，茜蒂考了三次才通过。
6.note: 对比结构 In contrast to；一般过去时。

7.concept: 主谓一致 — Collective subject — family as plural
7.zh: 一家四口被叫上台领奖时非常激动。
7.note: 集体名词 family of four 谓语复数 were；一般过去时。

8.concept: 动名词 — Gerund after object to
8.zh: 小男孩反对在开阔海域游泳，担心大浪。
8.note: object to + 动名词；陈述句一般过去时。

9.zh: 级长关上身后的门，好和校长私下谈话。
9.note: behind 表关上门形成私密空间；一般过去时。

10.concept: 分词 — Perfect participle — Having + V3
10.zh: 帮妈妈洗完菜后，莎拉摆好餐桌准备晚餐。
10.note: help someone (to) do something（帮助某人做某事，其中的 to 可以省略，直接接动词原形）。

11.stem_plain: The pupils are encouraged to _______ the meaning of unfamiliar words in the dictionary.

12.stem_plain: When Heidi's uncle offered her a trip to Europe, she _______ the opportunity immediately lest he change his mind.

13.stem_plain: The movie _______ the main character as a child genius who was able to read at a very early age.

14.stem_plain: Not wanting to be known, Mrs Tan gave _______ tip-off to the police, leading to the arrest of the culprit.

15.stem_plain: The doctors and nurses worked tirelessly to help the hundreds of _______ in the recent train crash.

11.zh: 鼓励学生用词典查阅生词义。
11.note: 应选（1）look up：查词义固定搭配。
11.concept: 词汇辨析 — look up（查阅）

choices.zh: 查阅，查找；（情况）好转，改善（动词短语，指在字典、参考书或电脑数据库中检索特定词汇或信息，亦可形容经济、局势或运势逐渐好转）
choices.eg: The primary school pupils are constantly encouraged to look up the exact meaning of unfamiliar vocabulary words in the English dictionary.

choices.zh: 调查，审查；深入研究（动词短语，指警察、官方机构或管理层对某一问题、罪行、投诉或突发事件展开深入、系统的查明与分析）
choices.eg: The school management promised to look into the parents' complaints regarding the lack of nutritious food options available at the canteen.

choices.zh: 看不起，轻视；蔑视（动词短语，习惯搭配为 look down on/upon，指因为某人的社会地位低下、贫穷、缺乏教育或犯过错误，而自以为是地瞧不起对方）
choices.eg: It is highly unethical to look down on individuals who work in blue-collar service jobs, as every honest profession deserves equal respect.

choices.zh: 浏览，快速查阅；看穿（动词短语，指飞快地翻阅书籍、文件或报告以获取大意，或者指透过物体的缝隙看过去，亦可指看穿某人的谎言）
choices.eg: The chief editor decided to look through the thick stack of student essay submissions before selecting the final winner for the writing prize.

12.zh: 叔叔提出欧洲之旅，她立刻抓住机会，怕他反悔。
12.concept: 词汇辨析 — seized（抓住（机会））

choices.zh: 锁住，锁上；固定（动词，指用钥匙或电子锁将门、抽屉或建筑物等牢固地锁起来以防他人进入，亦指关节、机械因卡住而无法动弹）
choices.eg: The security guards made sure that they had locked all the emergency exits securely before leaving the school campus for the weekend.

choices.zh: （敏捷或用力地）抓住，夺取；把握（机会）（动词，指用手迅速抓紧某物，或指警察依法没收违禁品、军队夺取阵地，亦极常用于比喻迅速把握转瞬即逝的机会、股份或权力）
choices.eg: When Heidi's wealthy uncle generously offered to sponsor her a graduation trip to Europe, she seized the golden opportunity immediately lest he change his mind.

choices.zh: 寻求，寻找；试图（动词，seek 的过去式和过去分词，高级学术用语，指为了解决困难、实现目标而主动去寻找他人的帮助、建议、支持或特定的资源）
choices.eg: The stranded victims of the flash flood actively sought shelter on the flat roofs of their houses while waiting for the rescue boats to arrive.

choices.zh: 发现，看见；认出（动词，指在众多人群、杂乱环境或极远的距离外，由于目光敏锐而突然看到、注意到某个特定的人、动物或微小的细节）
choices.eg: The alert birdwatcher was incredibly delighted when he spotted a rare migratory eagle resting on the highest branch of the mangrove tree.

13.zh: 电影把主角刻画为早慧的儿童天才。
13.concept: 词汇辨析 — depicts（描绘；刻画）

choices.zh: 定义，给……下定义；阐明（动词，指用精准、简练的语言解释一个词汇、概念的本质含义，或者指阐明某项政策、范围的边界与特征）
choices.eg: The introductory chapter of the textbook clearly defines the fundamental laws of physics before moving on to practical formulas.

choices.zh: 描绘，刻画；描写（动词，指通过绘画、雕刻等艺术形式表现出某人或某景，亦指在小说、电影或文章中用文字生动地塑造、展现人物形象或时代背景）
choices.eg: The biographical movie beautifully depicts the main character as a child prodigy who was already able to read complex classical literature at a very early age.

choices.zh: 描述，描叙；叙述（动词，指用语言或文字将某个人、物体、地点或事件的外表、特征、经过详细地讲解或记录下来，让听众在脑海中形成画面）
choices.eg: The eyewitness was able to describes the physical appearance of the fleeing suspect so accurately that the police quickly generated a composite sketch.

choices.zh: 证明，论证；示范，演示（动词，指通过出示确凿的证据、实验数据来清晰地表明某一事实或真理，或者指亲自操作、表演某个动作以进行教学示范）
choices.eg: The experienced chemistry instructor always demonstrates the correct way to handle reactive chemicals before letting the students begin their laboratory work.

14.zh: 陈太太匿名向警方提供线索，从而抓获罪犯。
14.concept: 词汇辨析 — an anonymous（匿名的）

choices.zh: 看不见的，未被察觉的；隐藏的（形容词，常带冠词，指由于物理阻隔、距离遥远或刻意隐藏，导致肉眼无法直接看到或察觉到的存在）
choices.eg: The research submarine used advanced sonar technology to detect an unseen coral reef hidden deep beneath the murky ocean surface.

choices.zh: 伪装的，乔装打扮的；掩饰的（形容词，常带冠词，指为了不被别人认出自己的真实身份、意图或外观，而故意改变服饰、声音或外在形态）
choices.eg: The detective wore a wide-brimmed hat and dark glasses as a disguised customer to spy on the suspicious activities inside the café.

choices.zh: 隐藏的，隐蔽的；隐匿的（形容词，常带冠词，指某样具体物件（如摄像头、武器）或抽象感觉被故意藏在某处、不让人轻易发现或看见）
choices.eg: The security guards discovered a concealed microphone built into the wooden frame of the conference room table during their sweep.

choices.zh: 匿名的，不具名的；无名氏的（形容词，常带冠词，指某人故意不公开、不透露自己的真实姓名、身份或出处来发表言论、寄信、捐款或举报）
choices.eg: Not wanting her identity to be known to the public, Mrs Tan gave an anonymous tip-off to the police, leading to the swift arrest of the culprit.

15.zh: 医护人员不辞辛劳救助火车事故中的众多伤员。
15.concept: 词汇辨析 — casualties（伤亡人员）

choices.zh: 病人，患者（名词，指正在接受医生、护士或其他医疗人员诊断、看护、药物治疗或手术的人）
choices.eg: The family clinic was crowded with several flu patients who were waiting patiently to see the general practitioner.

choices.zh: 死亡人数，致命事故（名词，专门指在战争、重大自然灾害、突发事故或暴力犯罪中，直接导致人类死亡的生命损失人数）
choices.eg: The local authorities were deeply relieved to announce that there were absolutely no fatalities recorded during the severe earthquake.

choices.zh: 伤亡人员，受害者（名词，集合名词，指在战争、重大车祸、灾难性事故或暴乱中，所有受到身体伤害以及不幸死亡的人员总称）
choices.eg: The hospital doctors and emergency nurses worked tirelessly throughout the night to treat the hundreds of casualties from the recent train crash.

choices.zh: 袭击者，攻击者（名词，指用武力、暴力、武器或者言语上，故意向他人发起身体攻击、殴打、抢劫或刺杀行动的犯罪人员）
choices.eg: The alert security officers managed to chase down and restrain the two armed assailants before they could escape from the bank.

16.concept: 近义词 — popular fixture（受欢迎的项目）
16.note: 短语 popular fixture 意为颇受欢迎且常设的项目或活动。在形容某种课程或活动备受青睐的命题语境下，过去分词/形容词 favoured 意为受偏爱的、受欢迎的，是其最精准的近义词考点。

choices.zh: 著名的，出名的
choices.eg: The team traveled far to challenge themselves on the famous outdoor climbing wall.

choices.zh: 被选中的，精选的
choices.eg: A carefully selected group of professional athletes was invited to the international training camp.

choices.zh: 受欢迎的，常设的，受偏爱的
choices.eg: Rock climbing has successfully become a favoured fixture in many secondary school sports curriculums.

choices.zh: 受尊敬的，德高望重的
choices.eg: The young sprinters learned many valuable tactics from their highly respected national coach.

17.concept: 近义词 — have the idea（认为/想当然地以为）
17.note: 短语 have the idea 意为在缺乏确凿证据的情况下主观地认为、假定某事。动词 assume 意为想当然地认为、假定，在逻辑表意上直接与该考点对标。

choices.zh: 假定，想当然地认为
choices.eg: Many beginners assume that rock climbing demands great raw strength rather than precise body balance.

choices.zh: 建议，暗示，表明
choices.eg: Recent laboratory studies suggest a strong link between daily balanced diet and muscle recovery speed.

choices.zh: 推广，促进，宣传，晋升
choices.eg: The local sports council launched a new project to promote outdoor sports among teenagers.

choices.zh: 宣传，公布，张扬
choices.eg: The committee actively publicised the upcoming climbing competition across social media platforms.

18.concept: 近义词 — first and foremost（首先/主要地）
18.note: 习语 first and foremost 意为首先、首要地、主要是。在阐述核心本质或首要因素的学术语境中，直接对应高频副词 primarily（主要地，根本上）。

choices.zh: 起初，最初
choices.eg: Initially, she found traversing the steep wall difficult, but her confidence grew after thorough practice.

choices.zh: 通常，经常
choices.eg: Sport climbing is usually done indoors in Singapore to avoid the volatile humid tropical weather.

choices.zh: 主要地，首要地，根本上
choices.eg: Experienced instructors always remind pupils that rock climbing is primarily a skill-based sport.

choices.zh: 永久地，长年累月地，无休止地
choices.eg: The narrow mountain trail seemed perpetually wet due to the dense forest mist nearby.

19.concept: 近义词 — myriad（许许多多/大量）
19.note: 名词/形容词 myriad 意为无数、大量、许许多多。名词 a multitude of 意为大批、众多、许许多多，在修饰可数名词复数时，在完形测试中属于直接的近义替换。

choices.zh: 清单，目录
choices.eg: The supervisor asked the assistant to make a detailed list of safety equipment before the expedition.

choices.zh: 过剩，剩余的部分
choices.eg: The engineering rescue team carried a surplus of durable dynamic rope in case of emergency.

choices.zh: 精选，选择，范围
choices.eg: The newly opened holiday resort offers a wide selection of challenging climbing routes for tourists.

choices.zh: 大量，众多，大批
choices.eg: To complete the vertical climb efficiently, an athlete must master a multitude of delicate techniques.

20.concept: 近义词 — sense of achievement（成就感/满足感）
20.note: 短语 sense of achievement 意为通过努力战胜困难后获得的成就感、满足感。这在心理状态描写的题目中，直接对标名词 satisfaction（满足，满足感）。

choices.zh: 欢欣，得意洋洋（常指极度兴奋、雀跃的心理状态）
choices.eg: She experienced an intense surge of elation when her hand finally reached the top ledge.

choices.zh: 抱负，大志，渴望
choices.eg: His ultimate academic aspiration is to discover a breakthrough in sustainable green technologies.

choices.zh: 期盼，期待，预期
choices.eg: The young students waited near the entrance gate in eager anticipation of the sports event.

choices.zh: 满足感，满意
choices.eg: The profound satisfaction of reaching the difficult summit made all the gruelling training worth it.

cloze: The sport of climbing has seen a surge in interest in recent years. Climbing has also become a [Q16 (popular fixture)] among co-curricular activities in many schools in Singapore.

When people think of climbers with their lean frames and toned forearms, many [Q17 (have the idea)] that climbing demands a great deal of power and strength. While those attributes matter, climbing is [Q18 (first and foremost)] a skill sport — one that requires creative problem solving and an acute sense of balance. A [Q19 (myriad)] of techniques are also needed to ascend a climb in the most efficient manner possible.

When climbers reach the top, the [Q20 (sense of achievement)] they experience leads to a deep feeling of euphoria. For those who are looking for an alternative to traditional competitive sports, climbing might just be it.
zh: 近年来攀岩运动越来越受欢迎，也成为新加坡许多学校课外活动中颇受欢迎的项目。
人们常以为攀岩只靠力量，但攀岩首先是技巧运动，需要创意、平衡和多种攀爬技术；登顶时的成就感会带来强烈的欣快感，是不喜欢传统竞技运动者的好选择。

21.stem_plain: Why is **'CMT'** written entirely in capital letters?

options.2: It is part of a name.
options.3: It is to show that it is important.
options.4: It is formed from the first letters of other words.

23.stem_plain: Harry started Mocha on Canine Massage Therapy treatment because he wanted _______.

options.3: Mocha to sleep soundly every night
options.4: to check if the vet's medications would work well with it

24.stem_plain: Why is **"Benefits of Canine Massage Therapy"** (page 9) an appropriate sub-heading for that section?

options.1: CMT is an intense massage treatment.
options.2: Every dog's existing health issues vary.
options.3: Dogs can benefit from having a better posture.
options.4: Dog owners can expect their dogs to reap overall health benefits.

25.stem_plain: Which of the following statements about Doctor Amara Tan is true?

options.1: She helps dog owners call for transport.
options.3: She provides counselling services for shelter dogs.
options.4: She has worked with the animal shelters for over a decade.

26.stem_plain: Mr Kwan owns two dogs. He will be able to enjoy the discount for Canine Massage Therapy treatment at K9 Wellness Clinic if he _______.

options.2: visits the clinic whenever he is free
options.3: visits their website for more information
options.4: brings his dogs for the treatment in September

27.stem_plain: Which of the following words on page 9 tells us that the goody bag is free?

28.stem_plain: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?

options.1: to share information on Doctor Amara Tan
options.2: to promote the clinic's Canine Massage Therapy services
options.3: to advise dog owners on how to help their sick dogs get better
options.4: to educate dog owners on the purpose of Canine Massage Therapy

21.concept: 题型 — Text feature — acronym（题型考点）

22.note: Ad about canine massage for dog owners → (2) dog owners.

23.concept: 目的 — Purpose of treatment（目的考点）
23.note: Harry wanted Mocha to recover from injury faster → (1) help Mocha recover faster.

24.concept: 题型 — Sub-heading fit（题型考点）
24.note: Section lists overall health benefits for dogs → (4) owners can expect overall health benefits.

25.concept: 细节 — Detail check — vet（信息定位）
25.note: Dr Tan provides home-based veterinary services → (2).

26.concept: 题型 — Promotion condition（题型考点）
26.note: Discount when treatment in September → (4) brings dogs in September.

27.concept: 题型 — Vocabulary in context（题型考点）

28.concept: 主旨 — main purpose（主要目的）
28.note: Ad promotes clinic CMT services → (2) promote Canine Massage Therapy.

cloze: It is a common misconception that in order to be happy, you have to be wealthy. Money is needed to pay for our basic necessities but in modern day society, [Q29] can be easy to assume that the more money we have, the happier we will be.

Indeed, money can buy you [Q30] abundance of material goods. [Q31] able to indulge ourselves in things we want such as the new iPhone, can make us feel very good. It is this feeling of pleasure which can lead to a false belief that money [Q32] buys happiness. With more money, we may end [Q33] buying more things than what we need. Those things, however, do not necessarily bring lasting joy and happiness [Q34] with them.

[Q35] of buying things, we should be creating new and exciting experiences that we can remember for a lifetime. We should spend time [Q36] the people we love and cherish those moments we experience with them. It is often hard to remember [Q37] lucky we are and be thankful for all the positive things happening in [Q38] lives. With gratitude in our heart, we can lead a happier life.
zh: 人们常误以为要快乐就得富有。金钱用于基本需求，但在现代社会里，很容易以为钱越多就越幸福。
金钱的确能买到大量物质；能尽情买想要的东西会让人感觉很好，但这可能让人误以为金钱带来幸福；钱多了还可能买超出所需，这些东西未必带来持久快乐。
与其买东西，不如创造可铭记的体验，与所爱之人共度并珍惜时光；要记得自己有多幸运、对生活中的好事心存感激，才能更快乐。

29.note: 句中 it can be easy to assume that … 为 it 作形式主语，真正主语是后面的 to assume 不定式；they / that 不能充当此结构的形式主语。故填'G — it'。

30.note: an abundance of material goods 中 abundance 以元音音素开头，须用 an；固定搭配 an abundance of = 大量的。故填'B — an'。

31.note: Being able to indulge ourselves … can make us feel very good 句首用 Being + 形容词/ able 构成动名词短语作主语，表'能够……这件事'。故填'C — being'。

32.note: 快感让人误以为'钱因此就能买来幸福'；therefore 承上引出这一错误推论，表结果/所以。故填'L — therefore'。

33.note: end up buying more things than what we need 为固定搭配，表'最终去做某事'；缺词为 up，与 end 构成 end up。故填'P — up'。

34.note: bring lasting joy and happiness along with them 中 along with = 连同……一起；物质未必连带带来持久快乐。故填'A — along'。

35.note: Instead of buying things, we should be creating … experiences 表'与其买东西，不如……'；Instead 与 of 连用，后接动名词 buying。故填'F — Instead'。

36.note: spend time with the people we love 中 with 表'与……在一起共度时光'。故填'Q — with'。

37.note: remember how lucky we are 中 how + 形容词 lucky 引导从句，表'记得自己多么幸运'。故填'E — how'。

38.note: all the positive things happening in our lives 与全文 we / thankful 呼应，指'我们生活中'的好事，用 our。故填'H — our'。

cloze: The origins of Dragon Boat Festival can be traced to ancient China. The festival [Q39(evolived)] from the practice of revering the river dragon. It was also a mark of respect to the poet Qu Yuan, [Q40(the)] honourable man in ancient China.

Legend has it that the river dragon controlled the rain and people [Q41(warshiped)] the creature during the summer months. Qu Yuan, who lived during the period, was so [Q42(upsetting)] over the fall of his country to the Qin army that he threw himself into the Mi Luo River in [Q43(dispear)] . Some versions of the legend [Q44(suggesting)] that fishermen at the scene attempted to appease his [Q45(spirrit)] by throwing rice stuffed in bamboo stems into the river to prevent the fish [Q46(to)] eating his body. Others say that the rice [Q47(oferings)] were snatched by a river dragon and the rice had to be bundled in leaves instead and tied with five different coloured silk threads. The triangular rice dumplings thus became [Q48(antwined)] with the festivities. Yet another version tells of farmers rowing out in dragon boats in their [Q49(attempted)] to save Qu Yuan. Since then, dragon boat races have been held yearly to remember him.
Today, the Dragon Boat Festival [Q50(including)] boat races and eating of rice dumplings. It is a proud heritage of the Chinese culture.
zh: 端午节的起源可追溯至古代中国。这一节日由祭祀河龙的习俗演变而来，也是为了向中国古代诗人屈原这位高尚之士致敬。
传说河龙掌控降雨，人们在夏季月份祭祀它。生活在那个时期的屈原因国家被秦军攻陷而悲痛欲绝，在绝望中投入汨罗江。传说有版本称，现场的渔夫往江中投掷塞满糯米的竹筒，以安抚他的灵魂、防止鱼啃食他的遗体。另有说法称供品被河龙夺走，人们便改把粽子包在叶子里，用五色丝线捆扎；三角粽因而与节庆紧密相连。又一版本说，农夫乘龙舟出江抢救屈原；此后每年举行龙舟赛以纪念他。
如今，端午节包括赛龙舟和吃粽子等活动。它是中华文化引以为豪的遗产。

cloze: Have you ever thought of donating to help people in need? Sharing what we [Q51] helps others live happier lives. Many people also give back because they are grateful for what was given to them.

There are many ways to give. Charities are organisations [Q52] recruit volunteers to raise money and donate time to support worthy causes. For example, the Red Cross collects donations and enlists volunteers for disaster relief. It brings food and medicine [Q53] victims of floods, fires, and earthquakes.

There are many charities seeking donations. Choosing the [Q54] one is important. You want to be sure that the charity is supporting a cause you believe [Q55]. You also want to make sure that your money is used to support the cause and not for [Q56] else.

Apart from donating money, you can also volunteer your time. When doing so, you get to mingle and talk to people who [Q57] in desperate need of help. You can also volunteer your talents. Let's say you are good at [Q58] sports, reading or baking. What charities could use these talents? If you are a good reader, you can tutor children who need help in reading. If you are a good baker, you can help to [Q59] the hungry. If you are good in sports, you can coach sports teams. This is how volunteering can [Q60] a difference in people's lives.

In 2006, Rick Reilly, a sports writer, wrote an article urging readers to donate at least $10 to [Q61] for a mosquito net for African children. Malaria is a disease [Q62] by mosquitoes. Mosquito nets are an important tool in [Q63] children from mosquito bites while they sleep. Reilly's efforts helped create the "Nothing But Nets" organisation. The term "Nothing but net" is used when the basketball goes through a hoop without touching the rim in matches. Reilly used this term as a play [Q64] words in his article. Reilly used his talent as a writer to show people the need [Q65] action.
Take action to support a charity you like today!
zh: 你有没有想过通过捐赠来帮助有需要的人？分享我们所拥有的可以帮助他人过上更幸福的生活。许多人也因为感激自己所得到的一切而选择回馈。
捐献的方式有很多。慈善机构是招募志愿者筹集资金并投入时间来支持高尚事业的组织。例如，红十字会募集捐款并招募志愿者参与灾害救援。它为洪水、火灾和地震的受害者提供食物和药物。
有很多慈善机构在寻求捐款。选择正确的机构很重要。你要确保该慈善机构支持的是你所信仰的事业。你还要确保你的钱是用于支持这项事业，而不是挪作他用。
除了捐钱，你还可以志愿献出你的时间。通过这样做，你可以与那些急需帮助的人交往和交谈。你也可以志愿贡献你的才华。假设你擅长体育、阅读或烘焙，哪些慈善机构可以利用这些才华呢？如果你擅长阅读，你可以辅导需要阅读帮助的孩子。如果你是个优秀的烘焙师，你可以帮忙施食给饥饿的人。如果你擅长体育，你可以担任运动队的教练。这就是志愿服务如何改变他人生活的。

2006年，体育作家里克·赖利写了一篇文章，呼吁读者捐赠至少10美元为非洲儿童购买蚊帐。疟疾是一种由蚊子传播的疾病。蚊帐是保护孩子们在睡觉时免受蚊虫叮咬的重要工具。赖利的努力促成了“Nothing But Nets”组织的诞生。“Nothing but net”（空心入网）在比赛中是指篮球不碰篮筐直接穿过篮网。赖利在他的文章中利用这个术语玩了一个文字游戏。赖利发挥了他作为作家的才华，向人们展示了采取行动的必要性。
今天就为你支持的慈善机构采取行动吧！

51.concept: 主谓一致与代词宾语从句
51.note: 作为 what 引导的宾语从句谓语动词。分享我们所“拥有（have）”、“挣得（earn）”或“共享（share）”的东西，能够帮助他人生活得更幸福，故填动词原形。

52.note: 引导限定性定语从句，修饰表示事物的复数先行词 organisations（组织）。从句中缺少主语成分且先行词为物，故填入关系代词 which 或者是 that。

53.note: 与前面的动词 brings 完美组合。指红十字会将食物和医药运送、分发“给（to）”遭受洪涝、火灾和地震的灾民，以此合理引出物资的走向。

54.note: 修饰代词 one（指代前文的慈善机构）。结合后文“确认其支持的是你所认同的事业”，说明在众多组织中挑出那家“正确的”、“合适的”或“最好的”机构至关重要，故填 right / suitable / appropriate / best / proper。

55.note: 定语从句中与前面的动词 believe 完美组合。构成在各大主流名校考卷中屡次重复考核的核心专属搭配 believe in something，意为你所“笃信/认同”的事业。

56.concept: 复合不定代词语意对照
56.note: 与前面的名词 the cause 形成对比。指要确保自己的捐款真正用在刀刃上，而不是被挪作“其他任何（anything）”用途或“别处的”开销，故填不定代词 anything 或者是 something。

57.concept: 关系从句主谓一致与系动词
57.note: 由关系代词 who 引导的定语从句修饰表示人类的复数先行词 people。结合后面的介词短语 in desperate need，此处需填入复数现在时系动词 are，指代那些身处绝境、急需帮助的人。

58.note: 跟在介词短语 good at 后面，且与后面的 reading、baking 属于平行的并列动作。指如果你擅长“进行（playing / doing）”体育运动，必须使用动名词形式。

59.note: 帮助动词短语 help to... 后接动词原形。在探讨烹饪和饥饿的社会学场景下，指优秀的烘焙师能够帮助去“喂饱（feed）”或“救济（help/assist）”处于饥饿中的人们。

60.note: 前面有情态动词 can，后接动词原形。与后面的名词短语 a difference 完美组合，构成英语中极其核心和高频的专属习语 make a difference，意为在他人生活中“产生积极改变”。

61.concept: 情态动词后的短语动词原形
61.note: 动词不定式符号 to 后接动词原形。与后面的介词 for 以及名词短语 a mosquito net 完美组合，构成支付开销的特定短语动词 pay for，表示这笔捐款将用来“支付”买蚊帐的费用。

62.concept: 过去分词短语作后置定语
62.note: 修饰前面的单数名词 disease（疾病）。指疟疾是一种“由……携带（carried）”、“由……传播（transmitted/spread/caused）”的蚊媒疾病，需填入过去分词形式。

63.concept: 介词后的动名词与习语搭配
63.note: 介词 in 后面需要接动名词（V-ing）。与后面的宾语结构 children from... 完美组合，构成经典专属防范结构 protecting/keeping/saving children from...，意在“保护”儿童免受叮咬。

64.note: 与前置的名词 a play 极其后置的短语 words 完美组合。构成英语中用于形容文字游戏、谐音梗或文字双关的极高频标志性专属修饰习语 a play on words。

65.note: 用来连接前面的名词 the need 和后面的名词 action（行动）。完美契合高频常考的经典名词加介词专属固定句式 the need for something，意为向人们展示采取行动的“必要性/紧迫需求”。

paragraphs.1: 我难以置信地盯着那一页，眼睛几乎瞪出来。我的名字下潦草地写着“Sarah - The Mop”，我才明白是在说我乱蓬蓬的卷发！心跳加速，脸和耳朵烧得通红，只想躲开“Slam”簿里那些伤人的话。
paragraphs.5: 十二岁还要搬去新国家，我想不出比这更糟的事；在新学校交朋友，又读到这么伤人的话，我实在承受不了。
paragraphs.8: 数学课上我看见那本黑簿子从桌子传到桌子；老师一转身看白板，书就飞快传下去。传到我桌上我打开，看见了那些话——恶毒的评论像刀子扎进心里。翻了几页，发现是班上男生写的，真不友善。
paragraphs.13: 他们为什么写这些？我才来学校一个月，还不认识他们。好不容易建立的自信碎了；我想交朋友，但他们彼此认识多年，并不容易。
paragraphs.16: 我继续翻，只看到其他女生的名字。
paragraphs.18: “Courtney——女巫般的尖鼻子、瞎得像蝙蝠”
paragraphs.19: 我才刚开始认识 Courtney。她就住在我家拐角处，有些早上我们一起走路上学。
paragraphs.21: 接下来几天那本恶簿仍在传阅。我知道必须阻止，但怎么做？分清对错不难，难的是去做；我得鼓起并不充足的勇气，实在算不上勇敢。
paragraphs.25: 我不敢告诉老师，也不敢对男生大吼大叫。最后我只能拒绝参与。
paragraphs.27: “不，我不读。”我紧张得结结巴巴地说。早些时候，男孩们会嘲笑任何拒绝参与的人。然而我只好反抗，哪怕得独自对抗；那时我正需要朋友，却已用尽勇气。
paragraphs.30: 当我发现其他女生也说不，包括 Amanda 和 Courtney，还有人撕掉写着自己名字的那几页，我受到鼓舞。所有女生都不参与后，男生很快失去兴趣；没有观众，簿子渐渐被遗忘——“拿走奖励，行为就会停止”的老话应验了，我们消除了那种“奖励”。
paragraphs.35: 我也学会理解并接纳与人的不同。我欣赏 Amanda 的厚唇和浓眉——后来才知那是许多模特和明星渴望的特征。Courtney 视力不好，却机智过人；她总能逗我笑，和她在一起从不无聊。我们成了最好的朋友。
paragraphs.40: 至于我，“The Mop”这个外号一直留着。我看着天生卷曲、不服管束的头发，最终学会了喜欢它；它不会被驯服，我也不会。

80.note:
1. 题型：对绰号“The Mop”态度如何变化（2 分）。
  2. 证据：行 1–4 羞辱感；行 40–42 eventually came to love 卷发，接纳自我。
  3. 答：起初因卷发羞辱尴尬 → 最终接受并喜欢自己的头发/外号。
answer: Initially, the author was embarrassed about her curly hair but eventually she came to accept it.
